library(ggplot2)
#Initialisation of vectors
set.seed(1)
n <- 100
X <- 1:n
e <- rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 0.2)
Y <- sin(X/10) + e
smth <- numeric(n)


#Lowess function creation
customLowess <- function(x,y,f){
  k <- ceiling(n*f)
  for(i in X){
    X_i = X[i]
    distances <- abs(X - X_i)
    knn_indices <- order(distances)[0:k+1]
    knn_distances <- distances[knn_indices]
    knn_values <- X[knn_indices]
    dmax = knn_distances[k+1]
    XM = cbind(1,knn_values)
    W <- matrix(0, nrow = k + 1, ncol = k + 1)
    YM = rep(1,k+1)
    for(j in 0:k+1){
      W[j,j]=(1-(knn_distances[j]/dmax)^3)^3
    }
    for(p in 1:k+1){
      a = knn_values[p]
      YM[p] = Y[a]
    }
  B <- solve(t(XM)%*%W%*%XM)%*%t(XM)%*%W%*%YM
  y_hat = B[1] + B[2]*X_i
  smth[i]=y_hat
  }
  return(smth)
}

ans = customLowess(X,Y,f=0.3)
L <- lowess(X,Y,f=0.3,iter=0)
plot(X, Y, type = "o", col = "black", main = "Plot of smoothing function comparison",ylab = "Y", xlab = "X")
lines(X,ans,col="blue",lwd=2)
lines(L, col="red",lwd=2)
